metadata.datasource: Measured off Agfa-Gevaert, AGFAPAN APX 400 PROFESSIONAL technical data (status 08/1995, 1st edition), 35 mm, with Agfa's Professional range sheet (09/1998), which plots the same; the density curve names no developer and measures gamma 0.655, as the sheet's gamma-time plot gives its rated developments (REFINAL 6 min ISO 400); the sheet's RMS 14.0 is for REFINAL, 6 min at 20 C. Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with the ISO speed point (0.10 over base + fog) 1.007 decades below mid-grey, box speed ISO 400; base + fog 0.158. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: Agfa's curve as plotted (to an equal-energy spectrum, read at density 1.0 above minimum density, as Agfa's range sheet says of all its films' plots). One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
